about: Fixes which workbooks may be used to tune the format, prompt and runner (dev) and which are held out for the final run only. See docs/PROTOCOL.md section 3. Any workbook not listed under dev is held out, so a newly added workbook is fenced by default.

held_out.note: SpreadsheetBench-derived workbooks are named sb_<task id>; real-world workbooks will be rw_<name>. Their files stay out of git or are added only with their own review, but the split applies to them by name.

subset.note: Seed for drawing a random subset of the held-out workbooks (api_run.py --subset N). Fixed here, before any held-out result exists; the size is chosen with the cost estimate and recorded with the run.
